ArtifactView.title: ArtifactView
ArtifactView.description:
Artifact plus evidence metadata stored on its artifact_added event.

Historical artifacts whose event payload predates evidence classification
default to ``other`` with no claimed capture time.

ModelServiceUpdate.title: ModelServiceUpdate
ModelServiceUpdate.description: Settings update; an omitted api_key keeps the existing secret.

ToolProposalRecord.title: ToolProposalRecord
ToolProposalRecord.description:
One immutable-arguments tool proposal plus its approval/execution state.

The row is the authoritative state; every transition is also written to the
append-only challenge event chain in the same SQLite transaction.

WriteupDraft.title: WriteupDraft
WriteupDraft.description:
A human-edited Writeup saved by the player for one challenge.

This is intentionally distinct from the generated preview: content is
player-authored, never represented as an observed execution or AI output.

WriteupRequirement.title: WriteupRequirement
WriteupRequirement.description: One completeness dimension with explicit proven/missing/N/A state.
